messages:
alex: Heads-up — autoscaler is still over-provisioning GPUs in eu-west when a handful of pods show up. Thinking about switching expander to "least-waste" and nudging scale-down thresholds. Any objections?

maria: +1 to least-waste but we saw fragmentation last sprint. Can we try a consolidation/canary first? Maybe lower max-node-utilization instead of immediate global change. :thinking_face: 

jin: Quick Q — which flags specifically? scale-down-utilization-threshold vs unneeded-time vs balance-similar-node-groups?

alex: Proposal for canary: --expander=least-waste --max-empty-bulk-delete=2 --scale-down-utilization-threshold=0.5 --scale-down-unneeded-time=10m --scale-down-delay-after-add=4m

sam: 0.5 utilization might be aggressive during spikes. Can we route only a small subset of traffic to the canary nodepool? Also prefer canary nodepool with smaller min-size.

maria: agree on traffic split. Also make sure --skip-nodes-with-local-storage is false for the canary since some GPU jobs use /scratch.

jin: Suggest setting --max-empty-bulk-delete=1 initially; we had a mass delete during a past network flap. Safer to start conservative.

alex: Good call. I'll set max-empty-bulk-delete=1 for the canary and keep it at 2 for non-canary until we observe.

sam: What's our scan-interval right now? If it's 10s we might get noisy decisions. Bump to 15s/20s for stability.

alex: Current is 10s. For the canary I'll set scan-interval=15s and monitor. Also enabling --balance-similar-node-groups to avoid cross-group thrashing.

maria: For ap-southeast we should use a longer --scale-down-unneeded-time because cold start & provisioning are slower there. Keep region-specific profiles.

jin: I'm going to create a canary nodepool named gpu-consol-canary with same taints/labels, min=0, max=6, and node annotations so pods that tolerate-consolidation prefer it.

alex: Action items I have: create gpu-consol-canary, deploy updated helm values for cluster-autoscaler in eu-west, set scan-interval=15s, max-empty-bulk-delete=1, utilization=0.5, unneeded-time=10m. Watch for 6 hours and report.

ops-bot: [PROD] deployment started: cluster-autoscaler-eu-west (image v1.23.0) by alex

maria: Add monitoring alerts: >3 node adds in 10m OR increase in scale-up errors. Also capture pod pending P95 before/after and node churn rate.

sre-bot: baseline metrics captured. dashboard link: https://dash.internal/redwood/k8s/autoscaler/canary (permission: eng-infra)

sam: I'll run a few load patterns at 14:00 UTC to exercise packing and fragmentation (burst + sustained). Will post results.

jin: Helm snippet I'm using for the canary deploy in case someone wants to repro: 
``` 
autoscaler:
  expander: "least-waste"
  extraArgs:
    max-empty-bulk-delete: "1"
    scale-down-utilization-threshold: "0.5"
    scale-down-unneeded-time: "10m"
    scale-down-delay-after-add: "4m"
    scan-interval: "15s"
    balance-similar-node-groups: "true"
```

maria: Side-note: draining GPUs takes longer due to checkpoint uploads. We may need to bump drain timeout or add a pre-drain hook to expedite checkpointing. If drains exceed eviction grace, pods leak and CA sees node as non-drainable.

alex: Opening runbook updates for drain behavior and adding a note in the canary doc. Also added a short doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/autoscaler/gpu-consolidation-experiment

ops-bot: [INFO] alert rule added to gpu-consol-canary by maria

sre-bot: Canary deployed. Initial 30m observation: avg pod pending time down ~12%, node churn down ~18%, no scale-up errors seen. Continuing to observe. :eyes:

maria: Nice. Keep it running for the 6h window, then we'll decide whether to roll to other regions with adjusted unneeded-time values. :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks team — will post final summary and proposed region-specific settings after the canary window.
